The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Smada]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] employed several [[Gank/Legends|Ganks]] as part of his entourage on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. During an outdoor confrontation with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Unidentified Gank minion 2|two]] [[Unidentified Gank minion 3|Ganks]] mysteriously disappeared into the planet itself when they attempted to harm the children. The other Ganks attempted to crowd onto Smada's [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]], but the Hutt knocked '''one''' off with his tail. That Gank was then swallowed by the planet as well.
